status: Exact necessary conditions and an implemented column-domain preprocessor; no 49-vertex feasible sample or full Conway graph constructed here

setup.root: Root x has 14 neighbours paired by c -> c xor 1. Choose a=0, a'=1, b=2, b'=3.
setup.far_labels: The 84 far vertices are the nonmatched unordered pairs of star letters.
setup.S: L_a union L_a' union L_b, size34. Intersections are p={a,b} and p'={a',b}; L_a and L_a' are disjoint.
setup.R: The root, its 14 neighbours, and S:49 vertices. Gamma is the full induced adjacency on S; B is the resulting induced adjacency on R.
setup.U: The other50 labels are nonmatched pairs among the11 letters outside {a,a',b}:40 avoid b' and10 contain b'. These labels are fixed by the root, not interchangeable anonymous columns.

column_domains.variables: For u in U, h is its binary adjacency vector to S. Its entries on the root and 14 star letters are already known.
column_domains.three_exact_sums: sum_La h=2, sum_La' h=2, sum_Lb h=2-delta, where delta=1 if b' belongs to u and0 otherwise.
column_domains.reason: Each of a,a',b is nonadjacent to u and has its entire neighbourhood in R. For b, the star letter b' supplies one common neighbour exactly when delta=1; a and a' have no such star contribution.
column_domains.partition: Write z=h_p and z'=h_p'. The disjoint groups L_a minus p, L_a' minus p', L_b minus {p,p'} have sizes11,11,10, with selected counts2-z,2-z',2-delta-z-z'.
column_domains.exact_unfiltered_count: N_delta=sum_(z,z' in {0,1}) C(11,2-z) C(11,2-z') C(10,2-delta-z-z'), with negative binomial indices giving zero.
column_domains.root_caps_enumeration: Imposing all root-star common-neighbour budgets further leaves94743 profiles for each delta0 label (84582/10044/117 of induced degree6/7/8), and25926 for each delta1 label (0/24776/1150). The matching group on the five other pairs is transitive on each of these two label types, so one representative per type suffices. Exact finite enumeration took0.343 seconds; no Gamma sample was used.
column_domains.scope: These counts impose only the three displayed sums. Common-neighbour caps, boundary capacities, kernel equations and spectral norms can further remove candidates. Their product is still enormous and is not an affordable total-search bound.

remaining_induced_graph.degree_formula: deg_G[U](u)=6+delta+h_p+h_p'. Since h_p+h_p'<=2-delta, every remaining degree is6,7 or8.
remaining_induced_graph.overlap_rows: The three star sums applied to p and p' give deg_Gamma(p)=deg_Gamma(p')=3-epsilon; hence each has9+epsilon neighbours in U.
remaining_induced_graph.double: d=1-epsilon-(Gamma^2)[p,p'] is the number of U vertices adjacent to both p and p'. It belongs to{0,1}; epsilon=1 forces d=0. Such a vertex cannot contain b', because its L_b budget would be1.
remaining_induced_graph.bprime: j=2-sum Gamma[v,w], over v in{p,p'} and w in{{a,b'},{a',b'}}, counts U vertices containing b' and adjacent to either p or p'. Each of p,p' has exactly one far neighbour labelled with b', and their two outside sets are disjoint, so0<=j<=2.
remaining_induced_graph.degree_histogram: n8=d+j; n7=28+2epsilon-2n8; n6=22-2epsilon+n8. The boundary therefore fixes the entire degree histogram of the unknown induced graph.
remaining_induced_graph.consequence: At most THREE of the50 remaining vertices have degree8; at most TWO when epsilon=1. The possible sets of degree8 labels number at most C(40,d) C(10,j)<=1800.
remaining_induced_graph.limit: This small bound concerns only the positions of degree8 vertices, not their edges, the other degrees' positions, or all completions.

exact_spectral_filter.K: 8 K_yz=3|y intersect z| + number of mate incidences between y and z -2.
exact_spectral_filter.matrix: M=8T_SS=24I-8Gamma-8K_SS is PSD and has rank<=30 for every actual Conway completion. The full84 by84 residual matrix has diagonal20, rank30 and nonzero eigenvalue56.
exact_spectral_filter.automatic_kernel: The three star indicator vectors lie in ker(M). At rank30, ker(M) has dimension4: there is at least one additional independent linear relation to impose on every remaining column.
exact_spectral_filter.column: For u in U, m_u=-8h-8K_Su. Require q dot m_u=0 for every exact null vector q of M. This is a system of linear integer equations in h.
exact_spectral_filter.norm: Choose a nonsingular principal block H=M[I,I]. For a column in range(M), m_u[I]^t H^-1 m_u[I]<=20. Equality is necessary when rank(M)=30.
exact_spectral_filter.deficit_budget: If rank(M)=r, put rho_u=20-m_u[I]^t H^-1 m_u[I]. Then sum_U rho_u=56(30-r). Indeed the full residual Gram matrix is56 times a rank30 projector; the known S-vectors span r dimensions, whose total squared projection over all84 frame vectors is56r, with680 contributed by S. Exact min/max bounds from the50 column domains must bracket this sum.
exact_spectral_filter.reconstruction: At rank30, any choice of all50 valid columns forces every residual entry: M_uv=m_u[I]^t H^-1 m_v[I], and adjacency on U is -(M_uv+8K_uv)/8. These values must be0 or1.
exact_spectral_filter.important_distinction: Full rank determines the remaining block AFTER the50 columns have been chosen. It does not uniquely determine those columns from B49 alone. No universal full-rank assertion is made.

global_compatibility.boundary_moments: For the complete cross matrix D, require D*1=14*1-B*1 and D*D^t=12I+2J-B-B^2.
global_compatibility.implemented: Individual profiles must respect zero capacities and known common-neighbour caps. Once all50 domains are complete, exact lower/upper marginal bounds are tested for every entry of DD^t. Degree-category Hall bounds also enforce the boundary-derived degree histogram.
global_compatibility.remaining_work: Selection of one profile per label satisfying all simultaneous moments and all induced 0/1 pair compatibilities is not implemented. A complete candidate would still be checked against the SRG equations; no existing peer graph is re-audited.
global_compatibility.count_bound: When residual rank is30, the product of exact necessary domain sizes is a certified upper bound on labelled SRG completions. It is generally far too large unless domains collapse; an empty exact necessary domain or incompatible marginal proves that supplied boundary cannot extend.

fractional_relaxation_witness.spectral_identity: For full root incidence D, Pi=I-D^t(DD^t)^(-1)D and T0=3I-Gamma0-K=3Pi. Thus0<=T0_SS<=3I<=7I.
fractional_relaxation_witness.exact_checks: All three-star equations, all natural off-diagonal boundary caps (B^2)_ij<=2-B_ij, and degrees<=14 hold. The smallest cap slack among far pairs in S is16/100.
fractional_relaxation_witness.rank: T0_SS has rank31 and nullity3. It therefore violates the rank<=30 necessary for a true Conway boundary.
fractional_relaxation_witness.meaning: The continuous relaxation with these local counts/caps and PSD cuts is feasible. Integrality and the additional kernel relation remain essential; no SRG or binary49-vertex object has been obtained. Other extra constraints can change the relaxation.
fractional_relaxation_witness.provenance: An explicit specialization of the previously derived forced operator E0; not a new general spectral-completion theorem.

peer_binary_psd_example.provenance: Claude bridge message697, accepted without an independent recomputation in accordance with Dilan's two-researchers instruction.
peer_binary_psd_example.reported_properties: A binary34-label three-star structure satisfying the peer's local constraints, with68 edges, T_SS PSD, and exact rational rank31.
peer_binary_psd_example.consequence: Local counts/caps plus integrality and PSD still do not imply rank<=30. This particular partial structure cannot extend to a Conway graph, because a principal submatrix cannot have larger rank than the full residual matrix, whose rank must be30.
peer_binary_psd_example.scope: An excluded partial configuration, not a global exclusion of C1 or an exclusion supplied by the new50-column domains. No rank<=30 input for that preprocessor has yet been supplied.

implementation.input: JSON with labels as34 pairs of integers0..13, and gamma (or adjacency) as a34 by34 binary symmetric matrix. Centres are0,1,2; mates are c xor1. Labels may be in any order and are normalized.
implementation.dependency: SymPy1.14.0 installed in the existing c1-lambda1-env for exact rational arithmetic.
implementation.bounded_execution: The enumeration has a time budget; incomplete domains are explicitly marked and never used to claim emptiness or a global count bound. Exact preprocessing runs before enumeration and can exceed that soft time budget.
implementation.checks: Own primitives checked: exact counts148346/31460, an added kernel relation giving12100/1210, and sparse versus dense rational norm evaluation. No real49-vertex sample has been processed yet.
